metadata.author: Carrie Brownell
metadata.description: Island of Stars is a middle grade, old-fashioned adventure story involving curious kids, a mysterious island, and grownups who may be hiding something nearly impossible to believe.  This historical fantasy novel takes readers along on an expedition with twins Bert and Betty and their friend, Cecily. Exploring an uninhabited island where their parents, marine biologists and mineralogists, are working for the summer, they discover much more than they bargained for. Weaving together history, mythology, and the magic that is childhood, Island of Stars explores classic themes of trust, courage, truth, and morality in this rollicking adventure.
